stops.note: to prick, to pierce, combined with ex- (out)
to prick out, to mark for deletion with dots, from ex- and pungere
stops.meaning: to prick out, to mark for deletion

stops.note: settled as the English word for completely erasing or removing something
stops.meaning: to completely erase or remove something

current_meaning: to completely erase or remove something, especially from a record
